## 1. Design: an Imprimatur marker on what Imprimatur owns

`scanSetup` (vscode/agent-setup.js) sets `by: "Imprimatur"` on an item when one of these holds:

- the file starts with Imprimatur's generated header (`<!-- Generated by Imprimatur`), as `.claude/rules/imprimatur.md` does;
- it is Imprimatur's own config: `.claude/imprimatur.json` or anything under `.claude/imprimatur/`;
- it is a skill whose folder resolves (through a symlink) into an Imprimatur checkout: `<checkout>/skills/<name>/`, where `<checkout>/package.json` is named `imprimatur`;
- it is an installed plugin whose id is `imprimatur@…`.

A hook is Imprimatur's when its command mentions `imprimatur` (its path or its `IMPRIMATUR_` env).

The tree puts `Imprimatur · ` at the start of the description of such a row: setup items, merged hooks and the hooks in "For <file>". A settings file that holds both Imprimatur's hooks and the user's own is not marked, since its hook rows already are.

Analyze: the detection is read-only and works per row. A false negative leaves a row unmarked, which is no worse than today. Nothing else reads `by`.
